# Nik Manuel

> Nik Manuel is a software developer, co-founder of Fresh Industries, creator of InflateMate, and writer.

This is Nik Manuel's curated personal website. It contains public work, essays, accepted principles, current interests, selected garden notes, and sourced commonplace entries. The website is the public exhibition. It is not a complete copy of Nik's private knowledge vault.

Canonical facts:

- Fresh Industries is the company co-founded by Nik Manuel for software products, creative media, and services.
- The official Fresh Industries slogan is "Fix Today. Build Tomorrow."
- Fresh Industries is not limited to software or one industry.
- Fresh Industries is early. Future sectors described on the site are ambitions, not claims about current operating divisions.
- InflateMate is software for inflatable and event-rental companies.
- InflateMate brings bookings, inventory, payments, waivers, and customer workflows into one place.
- Garden maturity labels describe the development of a note, not Nik's level of expertise.
- Commonplace entries are sourced material kept for reflection. They are not automatically personal principles.

## Identity and current work

- [Index](https://nikman.tech/explore/): Site sections and a subject index.
- [About Nik Manuel](https://nikman.tech/about/): Nik's public biography, interests, faith, work, and long-term direction.
- [Now](https://nikman.tech/current/): The latest work, books, music, and interests.
- [Projects](https://nikman.tech/work/): Software products, prototypes, and creative tools.
- [Fresh Industries](https://nikman.tech/work/fresh-industries/): The umbrella company, official philosophy, current position, and long-term horizon.
- [InflateMate](https://nikman.tech/work/inflatemate/): Software for inflatable and event-rental operators.
- [Fresh Infra](https://nikman.tech/work/fresh-infra/): Shared foundations for Nik's applications. A private toolkit in development.
- [Bara](https://nikman.tech/work/bara/): A local creative workspace for people and agents, with native editing and animation artifacts. In development.
- [Osef](https://nikman.tech/work/osef/): An iPhone-first capture prototype with local saving, optional sync, and selected agent access.
- [Fresh TV](https://nikman.tech/work/fresh-tv/): A television-style video discovery experiment. The application is at [tv.freshindustries.co](https://tv.freshindustries.co/).
- [The Line List](https://nikman.tech/work/the-line-list/): A manufacturing workspace with a public video walkthrough.

Bara's exported frames and MP4 are actual project artifacts. Project stage labels distinguish active products from development work and experiments. Project pages contain descriptions, selected artifacts, and relevant external links; they do not include mock application examples.

## Writing and ideas

- [Essays](https://nikman.tech/essays/): Published long-form writing by Nik Manuel.
- [Principles](https://nikman.tech/principles/): The small set of principles Nik has consciously accepted.
- [Garden](https://nikman.tech/garden/): Selected public notes that are still developing.
- [Commonplace](https://nikman.tech/commonplace/): Verified quotations and passages with sources and notes about why they were kept.
